title.zh: 五月下旬廣場帳篷區的疲態、外地學生增加與去留分歧
title.en: Late May in the Square: camp exhaustion, out-of-town students, and debate over leaving

summary.zh: 進入五月下旬，長期露宿令廣場帳篷區衛生條件惡化、人員疲憊不堪，許多北京本地學生陸續返校或減少留守，大批外地赴京聲援的學生則成為廣場駐紮主力。5 月 27 日聯席會議曾提出於 5 月 30 日撤離廣場的方案，但 28 日在留守派與外地學生反對下撤離決定遭到推翻，去留分歧愈發尖銳。
summary.en: By late May, deteriorating sanitation and exhaustion weighed heavily on the tent camp as many Beijing students returned to campuses while out-of-town students formed the bulk of those staying. On 27 May a joint coalition proposed withdrawing on 30 May, but on 28 May opposition from holdouts and provincial students overturned the plan.
